title: cassia fasciculata var. littoralis
intro: Cassia fasciculata var. littoralis, commonly known as Coastal Cassia or Sensitive Plant, is a variety of the Cassia fasciculata plant, which is a flowering plant native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Cassia fasciculata var. littoralis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as skin irritations and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
